description.text: The third Platinum set, released on 19 August 2009 with 153 cards: 147 numbered, three secret reprints of Articuno, Moltres and Zapdos, and three Shiny holos, SH7 to SH9. It visits the Battle Frontier of Pokémon Platinum with Frontier Brain's Pokémon (FB) and Champion's Pokémon (C) for Cynthia, and Team Galactic's Pokémon return; its Pokémon LV.X include Charizard G, Rayquaza C and Garchomp C. Its theme decks are Ignition and Overflow.
